commands.name: improve
commands.description: Improve a prompt with autoimprover (scored by running it); you review the result
commands.output:
error: give a prompt, --file PATH, --resume [ID], clean [ID] or cancel
usage:
/improve <prompt>                improve the prompt (it may span lines)
/improve [flags] <prompt>        a prompt that starts with -- goes after a lone --
/improve --file PATH [flags]     the prompt from a file
/improve --dry <prompt>          the plan only: no model call, nothing written
/improve --resume [ID]           continue the last run, or run ID
/improve clean [ID]              remove the last run's folder, or run ID's
/improve cancel                  stop the running run (it stays resumable)
flags: --file V, --examples V, --kind V, --time V, --deep, --workers V, --budget V, --strictness V, --allow-growth, --task-model V, --judge-model V, --reflect-model V, --target-model V, --effort V, --task-effort V, --judge-effort V, --reflect-effort V, --merge, --trust-search, --force-low-budget, --dry
